title: Experts disagree on src/stage-evidence/schema.ts
context:
Chief architect: Attribution is the goal; optional-and-nullable is the migration shape that lets it ship without rejecting rows an older engine wrote. The branch field set this precedent, so both are satisfied by one design.

Target: src/stage-evidence/schema.ts
- solution-architect: A stage row must record which agent produced it, so an isolated run and a single-context run are distinguishable from the bundle alone.
- solution-architect: The new attribution field must be optional and nullable so rows written by an older engine still validate.

[expert-conflict-fork:84cd368694f60ee4]

options.label: A stage row must record which agent produced it, so an isolated run and a single-context run are distinguishable from the bundle alone. — solution-architect
The new attribution field must be optional and nullable so rows written by an older engine still validate. — solution-architect

rationale: Owner OVERRODE the optional-and-nullable recommendation and chose required on every new row. Verified safe: validation is write-side only (readUnitFile -> readJsonl runs no validator), so historical rows stay readable. Every new row is written through appendFeatureStageRow, which will default the field to 'orchestrator' so the writer can always satisfy a required field.
